title.value: In-Processing fairness improvement methods for regression Data-Driven building Models: Achieving uniform energy prediction
title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the paper, capturing the core focus on improving fairness in regression models for building energy predictions.
title.quote: In-Processing fairness improvement methods for regression Data-Driven building Models: Achieving uniform energy prediction

extractions.description: This paper discusses methods to improve fairness in regression data-driven building models, specifically for energy prediction. The proposed in-processing methods add fairness-related penalties or constraints to the loss functions to ensure uniform predictive performance across different conditions, such as varying occupancy movements.
